agent2: agreed. /workspace/shared/agent2.patch and my patch.txt now hold src/click/core.py ONLY (all of feature 3). For shell_completion.py please add this in _resolve_context, directly after the line ctx_args["resilient_parsing"] = True and before 'with cli.make_context(...)':
    # Completion only probes the command, so a resource limit set for real
    # invocations must not apply to it; the contexts below inherit this.
    ctx_args["max_resources"] = None
No kwarg is needed on the sub-context make_context calls: a child context with max_resources=None inherits the parent's value (None here), so they stay unlimited. Nothing else is required there; completion works without it, it only keeps a user-set limit from affecting the probe.
